+"""Configurable SQLite database initialization and schema migration management."""
+import os
+import sqlite3
+from typing import Optional
+
+DEFAULT_DB_FILE = os.path.abspath(
+    os.getenv("APP_DB_PATH", os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "app_data.db"))
+)
+
+SCHEMA_SQL = """
+CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (
+    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
+    email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
+    password_hash TEXT,
+    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
+);
+
+CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS documents (
+    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
+    user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
+    title TEXT NOT NULL,
+    doc_type TEXT NOT NULL,
+    storage_path TEXT NOT NULL,
+    parsed_text TEXT,
+    status TEXT NOT NULL,
+    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
+    FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users(id)
+);
+
+CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS exam_blueprints (
+    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
+    source_document_id TEXT NOT NULL,
+    blueprint_json TEXT NOT NULL,
+    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
+    FOREIGN KEY(source_document_id) REFERENCES documents(id)
+);
+
+CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS generated_exams (
+    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
+    user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
+    source_blueprint_id TEXT,
+    title TEXT NOT NULL,
+    is_adaptive INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
+    status TEXT NOT NULL,
+    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
+    FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users(id),
+    FOREIGN KEY(source_blueprint_id) REFERENCES exam_blueprints(id)
+);
+
+CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS questions (
+    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
+    exam_id TEXT NOT NULL,
+    topic_id TEXT NOT NULL,
+    question_type TEXT NOT NULL,
+    difficulty TEXT NOT NULL,
+    prompt TEXT NOT NULL,
+    options_json TEXT,
+    expected_answer TEXT NOT NULL,
+    grading_rubric TEXT,
+    points INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
+    similarity_score REAL DEFAULT 0.0,
+    FOREIGN KEY(exam_id) REFERENCES generated_exams(id)
+);
+
+CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_questions_topic_id ON questions(topic_id);
+
+CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS exam_sessions (
+    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
+    exam_id TEXT NOT NULL,
+    user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
+    started_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
+    submitted_at TIMESTAMP,
+    total_score REAL,
+    max_possible_score REAL,
+    FOREIGN KEY(exam_id) REFERENCES generated_exams(id),
+    FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users(id)
+);
+
+CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS exam_answers (
+    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
+    session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
+    question_id TEXT NOT NULL,
+    student_response TEXT,
+    score_awarded REAL,
+    feedback_text TEXT,
+    graded_at TIMESTAMP,
+    FOREIGN KEY(session_id) REFERENCES exam_sessions(id),
+    FOREIGN KEY(question_id) REFERENCES questions(id)
+);
+
+CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS longitudinal_mastery (
+    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
+    user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
+    topic TEXT NOT NULL,
+    total_attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
+    successful_attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
+    mastery_rating REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0,
+    last_assessed_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
+    FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users(id),
+    UNIQUE(user_id, topic)
+);
+
+CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_longitudinal_mastery_topic ON longitudinal_mastery(topic);
+"""
+
+
+def get_connection(db_path: Optional[str] = None) -> sqlite3.Connection:
+    """Return a SQLite connection for the specified file-backed database path."""
+    target_path = db_path or os.getenv("APP_DB_PATH") or DEFAULT_DB_FILE
+    if target_path == ":memory:":
+        raise ValueError("In-memory sqlite databases are disallowed for persistent application storage.")
+    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(target_path)), exist_ok=True)
+    conn = sqlite3.connect(target_path)
+    conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON;")
+    return conn
+
+
+def init_db(db_path: Optional[str] = None) -> None:
+    """Explicitly initialize schema on the chosen database path."""
+    with get_connection(db_path) as conn:
+        conn.executescript(SCHEMA_SQL)

+"""Pydantic models for API request/response contracts and data definitions."""
+from datetime import datetime
+from typing import List, Optional
+from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field
+
+
+class DocumentResponse(BaseModel):
+    model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True)
+    document_id: str
+    title: str
+    doc_type: str
+    status: str
+    extracted_char_count: Optional[int] = None
+    created_at: Optional[datetime] = None
+
+
+class DocumentUploadAccepted(BaseModel):
+    document_id: str
+    status: str
+    message: str
+
+
+class JobAcceptedResponse(BaseModel):
+    job_id: str
+
+
+class JobStatusResponse(BaseModel):
+    job_id: str
+    status: str
+    progress_percentage: int
+    result_id: Optional[str] = None
+    error: Optional[str] = None
+
+
+class ExamGenerateRequest(BaseModel):
+    source_blueprint_id: str
+    study_document_ids: List[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
+    adaptive_mode: bool = False
+
+
+class QuestionItem(BaseModel):
+    question_id: str
+    sequence_order: int
+    question_type: str
+    prompt: str
+    options: Optional[List[str]] = None
+    points: int
+
+
+class ExamDetailResponse(BaseModel):
+    exam_id: str
+    title: str
+    total_questions: int
+    questions: List[QuestionItem]
+
+
+class SessionStartResponse(BaseModel):
+    session_id: str
+    started_at: datetime
+
+
+class StudentAnswerItem(BaseModel):
+    question_id: str
+    student_answer: str
+
+
+class SaveAnswersRequest(BaseModel):
+    answers: List[StudentAnswerItem]
+
+
+class SaveAnswersResponse(BaseModel):
+    status: str
+    last_saved_at: datetime
+
+
+class QuestionEvaluation(BaseModel):
+    question_id: str
+    score: float
+    max_score: float
+    is_correct: bool
+    feedback: str
+
+
+class SessionReportResponse(BaseModel):
+    session_id: str
+    total_score: float
+    earned_score: float
+    evaluations: List[QuestionEvaluation]
+
+
+class StudySummarizeRequest(BaseModel):
+    document_id: str
+    focus_topics: List[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
+
+
+class StudySummarizeResponse(BaseModel):
+    summary: str
+    key_points: List[str]

+
+
+class TopicMasteryItem(BaseModel):
+    topic: str

+
+class TopicRecommendation(BaseModel):
+    topic: str
+    suggested_action: str

+
+
+class ReadinessDashboardResponse(BaseModel):
+    overall_readiness_percentage: float
+    topic_mastery: List[TopicMasteryItem]
+    recommendations: List[TopicRecommendation]

+"""Tests for T1 backend slice: database schema initialization and OpenAPI contract definition."""
+import os
+import sqlite3
+import tempfile
+import pytest
+from pilot.app.backend.db import init_db, get_connection
+from pilot.app.backend.main import app
+
+
+def test_init_db_creates_expected_tables_in_temp_file():
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp_dir:
+        db_path = os.path.join(tmp_dir, "test_backend.db")
+        assert not os.path.exists(db_path)
+
+        init_db(db_path)
+        assert os.path.exists(db_path)
+
+        conn = get_connection(db_path)
+        cursor = conn.cursor()
+        cursor.execute("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table';")
+        tables = {row[0] for row in cursor.fetchall()}
+        conn.close()
+
+        expected_tables = {
+            "users",
+            "documents",
+            "exam_blueprints",
+            "generated_exams",
+            "questions",
+            "exam_sessions",
+            "exam_answers",
+            "longitudinal_mastery",
+        }
+        assert expected_tables.issubset(tables)
+
+
+def test_foreign_key_and_unique_constraints():
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp_dir:
+        db_path = os.path.join(tmp_dir, "test_constraints.db")
+        init_db(db_path)
+        conn = get_connection(db_path)
+        cursor = conn.cursor()
+
+        # Foreign key enforcement check (inserting document without user)
+        with pytest.raises(sqlite3.IntegrityError):
+            cursor.execute(
+                """INSERT INTO documents (id, user_id, title, doc_type, storage_path, status)
+                   VALUES ('doc_1', 'nonexistent_user', 'title', 'EXAM_SAMPLE', '/tmp/p', 'PENDING');"""
+            )
+            conn.commit()
+
+        # Insert valid user and document
+        cursor.execute("INSERT INTO users (id, email) VALUES ('u1', 'test@example.com');")
+        cursor.execute(
+            """INSERT INTO documents (id, user_id, title, doc_type, storage_path, status)
+               VALUES ('doc_1', 'u1', 'title', 'EXAM_SAMPLE', '/tmp/p', 'PENDING');"""
+        )
+        conn.commit()
+
+        # Verify longitudinal_mastery UNIQUE(user_id, topic) constraint
+        cursor.execute(
+            """INSERT INTO longitudinal_mastery (id, user_id, topic, total_attempts, successful_attempts, mastery_rating)
+               VALUES ('m1', 'u1', 'Algorithms', 1, 1, 1.0);"""
+        )
+        conn.commit()
+        with pytest.raises(sqlite3.IntegrityError):
+            cursor.execute(
+                """INSERT INTO longitudinal_mastery (id, user_id, topic, total_attempts, successful_attempts, mastery_rating)
+                   VALUES ('m2', 'u1', 'Algorithms', 2, 2, 1.0);"""
+            )
+            conn.commit()
+        conn.close()
+
+
+def test_memory_database_is_disallowed():
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        get_connection(":memory:")
+
+
+def test_openapi_contract_generation():
+    openapi_schema = app.openapi()
+    assert "paths" in openapi_schema
+    assert "/api/v1/documents" in openapi_schema["paths"]
+    assert "/api/v1/exams/generate" in openapi_schema["paths"]
+    assert "/api/v1/exams/sessions/{session_id}/report" in openapi_schema["paths"]
+    assert "/api/v1/diagnostics/readiness" in openapi_schema["paths"]
